movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Huacones carry whips (tronadores) used as symbolic gestures during dance
movement_profile.difficulty: Intermediate (requires moral integrity and inherited knowledge)
movement_profile.footwork: Elders dance with freedom and improvisation; younger huacones perform limited, circumscribed steps around elders
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Central village plaza; elders occupy central space with younger dancers moving around them
movement_profile.posture: Upright, authoritative posture reflecting moral authority

signature_moves.description: Elders perform free, improvised dance movements expressing authority
signature_moves.name: Improvised elder steps

signature_moves.description: Younger huacones move in limited steps around elders, symbolizing respect and subordination
signature_moves.name: Circumscribed younger steps

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Rhythmic and solemn, paced by the tinya drum
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Outsiders should not attempt to perform or wear masks; respect the sacred nature and moral requirements of the dance

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Not specified beyond tinya drum providing beat
music_profile.sound_description: The music centers on the steady beat of the tinya drum, providing a rhythmic foundation for the huacones' dance steps, accompanied by an orchestra playing varied rhythms that underscore the ritual's solemn and authoritative mood.

basic_steps: Stand in the village center with other huacones
Elders perform free and improvised steps with whips
Younger huacones move in limited, circumscribed steps around elders
Follow the rhythm of the tinya drum
Maintain solemnity and respect during movements
teaching.formation: Group formation with elders central and younger huacones moving around them
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by learning circumscribed steps around elders; advanced dancers (elders) improvise freely
teaching.rhythm: Set by the tinya drum; specific meter not described
